mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.difficulty, p.tags, p.time_limit_ms, p.memory_limit_mb, p.published, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS submissions, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.verdict = 'AC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS accepted, CASE WHEN COUNT(s.id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.verdict = 'AC' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1000.0 / COUNT(s.id)) / 10.0 END AS accept_rate FROM problems p LEFT JOIN submissions s ON s.problem_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.difficulty, p.tags, p.time_limit_ms, p.memory_limit_mb, p.published
mapper.select: SELECT id, ordinal, input, expected_output, points FROM test_cases WHERE problem_id = #{problemId} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problems (slug, title, difficulty, tags, statement, time_limit_ms, memory_limit_mb, published) VALUES (#{slug}, #{title}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{statement}, #{timeLimitMs}, #{memoryLimitMb}, #{published})
mapper.update: UPDATE problems SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, tags = #{tags}, statement = #{statement}, time_limit_ms = #{timeLimitMs}, memory_limit_mb = #{memoryLimitMb}, published = #{published} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_cases (problem_id, ordinal, input, expected_output, points, hidden) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{ordinal}, #{input}, #{expectedOutput}, #{points}, #{hidden})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal), 0) FROM test_cases WHERE problem_id = #{problemId}
